files.content: "use client" import { Card, CardContent } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const markers = [ { name: "Vitamin D", value: "32", unit: "ng/mL" }, { name: "Ferritin", value: "86", unit: "ng/mL" }, { name: "HbA1c", value: "5.2", unit: "%" }, { name: "LDL", value: "104", unit: "mg/dL" }, { name: "hs-CRP", value: "0.8", unit: "mg/L" }, ] export function CarouselDemo() { return ( {markers.map((marker) => ( {marker.name} {marker.value} {marker.unit} ))} ) }
